Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MPMKVVCL CS Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Madhya Pradesh Madhya Kshetra Vidyut Vitaran Company (MPMKVVCL) for filling up management trainee positions on a contract basis in the state of Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official recruitment notification has been released for the position of CS Management Trainee under advertisement number MD/MK/CA/7425 for eligible professional candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the CS Management Trainee post under this notification issued by Madhya Pradesh Madhya Kshetra Vidyut Vitaran Company.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed applications via email is 05-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they submit their documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for MPMKVVCL Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly via email. Candidates are required to send their complete application and documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the CS Management Trainee post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as CS Management Trainee will receive a consolidated monthly salary or stipend of Rs. 30,000/- p.m. during their contract period.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Professional Passed (preferably female) with EDP completed through online and offline mode, and 21 months training remaining as per ICSI guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or mentioned in the official notification released by MPMKVVCL for the CS Management Trainee position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of applications based on eligibility criteria followed by a final selection interview conducted by the company authorities.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to check updates?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official portal of Madhya Pradesh Madhya Kshetra Vidyut Vitaran Company at portal.mpcz.in to check regular recruitment updates and notifications.
